title: spec.skill.md Phase 5 should use write_file instead of patch_file for README row registration
description: Phase 5 of spec.skill.md instructs the agent to use patch_file for README row insertion. Repeated patch_file failures on long README table rows force write_file fallback every time, at the cost of 3 failed tool calls per run. Directing agents to use read_file + write_file directly for Phase 5 would eliminate this failure mode and reduce run_time and tool_errors.
proposed_resolution: Update Phase 5 of spec.skill.md to use read_file followed by write_file for .moeb/README.md updates, replacing the patch_file instruction. This is the same pattern as signal a1000002-0529-4003-8003-000000000003 (run.skill.md write_file for pure-insertion changes) applied to the spec skill.
